clos.original_description: Students will develop a solid understanding of the fundamental concepts and principles of text mining, including techniques for extracting, transforming, and analyzing textual data.
clos.enriched_description: Develop a solid understanding of fundamental text mining principles for extracting, transforming, and analyzing textual data, including regular expressions, text normalization, minimum edit distance, n-gram language models, smoothing, perplexity, entropy, vector semantics, TF-IDF, Word2Vec, and embedding evaluation.

clos.original_description: Students can use machine learning/deep learning (neural networks, neural language models, recurrent neural networks, LSMT) for specific text-mining applications.
clos.enriched_description: Use machine learning and deep learning methods for text-mining applications, including Naive Bayes text classification and sentiment analysis, logistic and multinomial logistic regression, model evaluation, cross-validation, RNNs, LSTMs, attention, transformers, pretrained language models, masked language models, and fine-tuning.

clos.original_description: Students will explore the methods and algorithms used for text classification and clustering tasks. They will learn to apply techniques like Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines, and k-means clustering.
clos.enriched_description: Explore methods and algorithms for text classification and clustering tasks, including Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machines, k-means clustering, unsupervised text clustering, document similarity, and topic modeling.

clos.original_description: Students will learn about different methods for representing text data, such as bag-of-words, term frequency-inverse document frequency (TF-IDF), and word embeddings. They will understand the strengths and limitations of each approach.
clos.enriched_description: Represent text data using bag-of-words, TF-IDF, and word embeddings, and evaluate their strengths and limitations through vector semantics, cosine similarity, pointwise mutual information, Word2Vec, embedding visualization, semantic properties, bias, and vector model evaluation.

clos.original_description: Students will be aware of the popular applications in text mining, such as machine translation, question answering, and chatbots to design text mining-related applications in real-world
clos.enriched_description: Recognize and design real-world text-mining applications such as machine translation, question answering, and chatbots, including encoder-decoder translation, low-resource translation, translation evaluation, dialogue-state architecture, chatbot design, and dialogue-system evaluation.
